errors.text_span: Das vorliegende Bild zeigt zwei diagonal rotierte, parallel angeordnete gestapelte Balkendiagramme
errors.evidence: The diagrams are not diagonally rotated; they are upright and parallel.

errors.text_span: der niedrigste Gesamtwert im letzten abgebildeten Zeitraum um 2023 bei etwa 1,3 % liegt
errors.evidence: In the left diagram, the total value for 2023 is just under 3%, not 1.3%.

errors.text_span: der höchste gestapelte Gesamtwert zu Beginn der Zeitreihe um das Jahr 1992 bei etwa 3,1 % liegt
errors.evidence: The highest value in the left diagram is over 3%, closer to 3.3%, not 3.1%.

errors.text_span: hier reicht der höchste Gesamtwert (schwarze Linie) zu Anfang der Zeitreihe an die 1,0 % heran
errors.evidence: In the right diagram, the highest value at the beginning of the time series is approximately 0.7%, not 1.0%.

errors.text_span: die blauen Balken für den Bund durchgehend unter die Nulllinie auf bis zu ca. -0,4 % abfallen
errors.evidence: In the right diagram, the blue bars for 'Bund' fall to approximately -0.2%, not -0.4%.
The description does not mention that the left diagram represents gross fixed capital formation and the right diagram represents net fixed capital formation.
The description does not mention the relative stability of gross investments between 2% and 3% of GDP after 2000 in the left diagram.
The description does not mention the significant decline of net investments into negative values after the early 1990s in the right diagram.
The description does not mention the vertical axis range (-0.5 to 3.5) or its units (% of GDP).
The description does not mention the annotation 'Bahnreform²' or the vertical dashed line marking its position.
